name: ng-starters
description: Reusable Angular/ng starter templates + Claude Code skills

scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node bin/sync-metadata-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: node bin/generate-skill-package-json.mjs --check && node bin/sync-skill-content.mjs --all && node bin/validate-skill-package.mjs --all && changeset publish
